note: Gains locked in (compare.py): each workload must cost at most atMost times another of the same run, in the same unit. Measured on macOS (wall clock) when set: layout/5000/change 0.007 of layout/5000, frame/blink/400/drawn 0.21 of frame/400, frame/blink/400 0.46 of frame/400;, editor/type-100k 3.4 of editor/type-1k, editor/scroll-1m 1.0 of editor/scroll-10k; the limits leave room for runners and callgrind.

locks.name: layout/5000/change
locks.why: one changed panel lays out only what it moves, not the whole tree

locks.name: frame/blink/400/drawn
locks.why: a blinking caret redraws only its damage region

locks.name: frame/blink/400
locks.why: a frame where nothing but the caret changed reuses the cached draw list

locks.name: editor/type-100k
locks.why: a key typed in a long file redraws only the visible lines: the file's length barely counts

locks.name: editor/scroll-1m
locks.why: a scrolled frame finds its rows by index, not by walking the lines above
